internalDomain.description: Base domain for internal service hostnames.

lanCIDR.description: LAN/node CIDR admitted by NetworkPolicies. No safe default.

storageClass.description: StorageClass for data the volume must protect. Empty uses the cluster default.

localStorageClass.description: StorageClass for data the application replicates itself or can re-derive. Empty uses the cluster default.

namespaceLabels.description: Extra labels on every namespace this layer creates (policy: all of namespaces.create; platform: garage.createCredentialsNamespaces). Labels the chart sets itself are refused.

namespaces.description: Namespace names. Prefixed defaults; override to legacy names when adopting into an existing cluster.

create.description: Keys from this map that the chart CREATES. Others are referenced only.

priorityClasses.description: PriorityClass names referenced by shipped workloads.

extraEgress.description: Raw NetworkPolicy egress entries appended verbatim for the console, e.g. a model host it is pointed at directly.

items.description: One NetworkPolicy egress rule, as the API server takes it: `to` (ipBlock, namespaceSelector, podSelector) and `ports` ({protocol, port}). Not {cidr, ports}, which is providerAllow's shape; that renders clean and fails at apply with `.cidr: field not declared in schema`.

namespaceDefaultDeny.description: Egress default-deny for the whole AI namespace with the companion allows (TM-0273 fix 1). Follows apps.ai_namespace. False is a rollback lever, not a tuning knob.

providerAllow.description: Where the model gateway may send traffic outside the namespace: {cidr, ports}. A cidr of exactly 0.0.0.0/0 automatically excludes the cluster, service and LAN CIDRs and 169.254.0.0/16. Empty list: nothing outside the namespace except extraEgress.

extraEgress.description: Raw NetworkPolicy egress entries appended verbatim for the gateway, e.g. a model host on the LAN. Lives in the site's policy.yaml (this is the policy layer), not ai.yaml.

items.description: One NetworkPolicy egress rule, as the API server takes it: `to` (ipBlock, namespaceSelector, podSelector) and `ports` ({protocol, port}). Not {cidr, ports}, which is providerAllow's shape; that renders clean and fails at apply with `.cidr: field not declared in schema`.

apiServerCIDRs.description: Kubernetes API endpoints for CNPG pods and the restore drill. Empty means lanCIDR on 6443 plus serviceCIDR on 443.

extraEgress.description: Raw egress entries appended verbatim for CNPG pods, e.g. an S3 endpoint that is not the shipped Garage.

items.description: One NetworkPolicy egress rule, as the API server takes it: `to` (ipBlock, namespaceSelector, podSelector) and `ports` ({protocol, port}). Not {cidr, ports}, which is providerAllow's shape; that renders clean and fails at apply with `.cidr: field not declared in schema`.

enabled.description: true or false to decide explicitly; unset or null to follow the owning capability.

propertyNames.description: Generated by tools/check-values-typos.sh --write: every component name any layer declares (TM-0404).

extraApiGroups.description: Extra API groups the identity may read.

apiServerCIDRs.description: The Kubernetes API endpoint(s) as narrow CIDRs (TM-0273 fix 2). Empty keeps the whole serviceCIDR and lanCIDR on 443/6443.

tockmox-common.description: The Tockmox library chart. It has no values interface; the block exists so a site cannot be surprised by a schema rejection if it sets one.

observability.description: Metrics, logs, and the ServiceMonitor/PrometheusRule objects this repo writes. Decline it and set apps.serviceMonitors.enabled to keep the monitors for your own Prometheus operator.

enabled.description: Unset means components follow this capability; true or false overrides.

notifications.description: Alerts that reach a person: the sink, the bridge and the heartbeat that proves the path. Its component switch is notifications.enabled, which predates this framework.

enabled.description: Unset means components follow this capability; true or false overrides.

identity.description: Single sign-on across every console, and the identity provider behind it.

aiPlane.description: The private AI plane: the chat console and the model gateway in front of it.

dataProtection.description: Backups that go somewhere, and the object store, backup plugin and snapshot control plane underneath them.

hardwareTelemetry.description: SMART and SNMP telemetry from physical hardware. Off by default, because the reference deployment is a virtual machine.

enabled.description: Unset means components follow this capability; true or false overrides.

workflowAutomation.description: Scheduled and event-driven jobs inside the cluster, with a console to watch them.

enabled.description: Unset means components follow this capability; true or false overrides.

networkPolicy.description: Default-deny between namespaces. Decline it on a CNI that does not enforce NetworkPolicy, where these objects are decoration.

capabilities.description: Named functional capabilities: one switch per functional story, spanning whatever components it takes across whichever layers they live in. CLOSED, unlike `global`: nothing upstream reads this block, so an unrecognised name here is always a typo, and an ignored typo means a capability you thought you declined is still on. See docs/administration/capabilities.md.

snapshot-controller.description: Not this layer's key. Owned by the platform layer. Accepted and ignored here because one values file is passed to every layer; see docs/administration/values-contract.md.

probes.description: Blackbox Probe objects. The exporter shipped with none, so it ran and measured nothing.

module.description: A module name from the blackbox exporter's own config.

consoles.description: Subdomain under global.internalDomain -> probe it or not.

platformNetpol.description: Tockmox-owned block: platformNetpol. The platform namespace's node-network, scrape and object-store ingress rules (TM-0273 fixes 3 and 4), plus the site-peer lists for the devops scrape rule and the monitoring namespace (TM-0820).

nodeOriginSources.description: Sources of node-originated traffic (per-node flannel gateway addresses). Empty keeps the whole clusterCIDR admitted to every platform pod, the insecure pre-0.7.0 rule. Print the list with install/tockmox-install.sh --print-netpol-node-sources.

scrapePorts.description: Container ports Prometheus may reach on platform pods; derived from the shipped ServiceMonitors.

extraS3ClientNamespaces.description: Extra namespaces allowed to reach the shipped object store's S3 port 3900.

extraPrometheusNamespaces.description: Extra namespaces whose Prometheus pods may scrape the platform and devops namespaces, beyond namespaces.monitoring.

extraMonitoringClientNamespaces.description: Extra namespaces whose pods may reach Prometheus, Loki and ntfy in the monitoring namespace (a site's own Alloy, capacity jobs, publishers).

podSecurity.description: Tockmox-owned block: podSecurity. The pod-security.kubernetes.io labels on every namespace this chart creates (TM-0135). Labels only.

warn.description: Level the API server warns at. Observes without blocking.

audit.description: Level written to the audit log. Observes without blocking.

version.description: Standard version for warn and audit.

enforce.description: Enforce level per namespaces.* key. Empty string renders no enforce label. tools/check-pod-security.sh fails a level stricter than the rendered pods pass.

enforceDefault.description: Level for a created namespace with no entry in enforce. Empty renders none.
